title: Well-Architected Framework Deep Dive
description: Deep dive into the 6 pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and learn how to apply them.

data.text: The **AWS Well-Architected Framework** helps cloud architects build secure, high-performing, resilient, and efficient infrastructure. It is built around six pillars, each with a set of design principles and best practices.

data.title: Well-Architected Pillars
items: **Operational Excellence** — run and monitor systems, improve processes, respond to events
**Security** — protect data, systems, and assets using risk assessments and mitigation strategies
**Reliability** — ensure a workload performs its intended function correctly and consistently
**Performance Efficiency** — use computing resources efficiently to meet requirements
**Cost Optimization** — avoid unnecessary costs while maximizing value
**Sustainability** — reduce the environmental impact of running cloud workloads

data.title: Operational Excellence Review Questions
data.content: Here are sample questions used during a Well-Architected Review for the Operational Excellence pillar.
data.code:
# Operational Excellence Pillar Questions

## How do you develop the capability to continually improve your workloads?
- [ ] Do you capture and evaluate logs and metrics?
- [ ] Do you use automation for routine tasks?
- [ ] Do you conduct regular incident reviews?

## How do you evolve organizational knowledge?
- [ ] Do you document runbooks and playbooks?
- [ ] Do you share lessons learned across teams?
- [ ] Do you use post-incident reviews to improve?

## How do you design your workload to enable experimentation?
- [ ] Do you use canary deployments or feature flags?
- [ ] Can you quickly roll back changes?
- [ ] Do you test in non-production environments?

terms.definition: AWS guidance for building secure, efficient, and reliable cloud systems.
A foundational area of focus within the Well-Architected Framework.
An assessment of your workload against the Framework's best practices.

data.title: Free Tool
data.text: The AWS Well-Architected Tool is available at no extra cost in the AWS Console. It guides you through a questionnaire and produces a report with improvement recommendations.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: The Framework has six pillars covering all aspects of cloud design
Each pillar has design principles and review questions
Use the free AWS Well-Architected Tool to assess your workloads
